# The New Jersey Statutes as one text file. A section opens with its catchline at the start of a line ("2C:33-24  "Act of
# graffiti.""); its body follows, tab-indented, sometimes repeating the number ("\t2C:33-24.  As used ..."), sometimes with a
# misprinted one ("\t2C:35-A-5." under 2C:35A-5), sometimes flush left as a second line for the same number. So a section is
# everything from its number's first catchline to the next number's. (A pattern took one-line bodies for headings and
# never matched the misprinted ones; 2026-10-07.)
import io, zipfile, re
ID = r'[0-9A-Z-]+:[0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\.[0-9A-Za-z]+)*'
CATCH = re.compile(r'(?m)^ {0,2}(?P<id>' + ID + r')\.?[ \t]+(?P<heading>\S[^\r\n]*?)[ \t]*\r?$')
def sections():
    url = 'https://pub.njleg.state.nj.us/statutes/STATUTES-TEXT.zip'
    kind, raw = fetch(url)
    data = raw if isinstance(raw, bytes) else raw.encode('latin1')
    t = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)).read('STATUTES.TXT').decode('latin-1')
    hits = list(CATCH.finditer(t))
    i = 0
    while i < len(hits):
        m = hits[i]; j = i + 1
        while j < len(hits) and hits[j].group('id') == m.group('id'):
            j += 1
        heading = m.group('heading').strip().rstrip('.').strip()
        if len(heading) > 200:                       # no catchline: the line is the body itself
            heading = ''
        body = t[hits[i + 1].start() if j > i + 1 else m.end():hits[j].start() if j < len(hits) else len(t)]
        if j > i + 1 or not heading:
            body = (t[m.start():m.end()] if not heading else '') + body
        lines = [re.sub(r'^\s*' + re.escape(m.group('id')) + r'\.?\s+', '', l.strip(), count=1) if k == 0 else l.strip()
                 for k, l in enumerate(x for x in body.split('\n') if x.strip())]
        if lines and heading:                        # the body's own number, even misprinted ("2C:35-A-5.")
            lines[0] = re.sub(r'^' + ID + r'\.?\s+', '', lines[0])
        text = '\n'.join(l for l in lines if l)
        if text:
            yield {'id': m.group('id'), 'heading': heading, 'text': text, 'url': url}
        i = j
